---
title: "EEG with Python"
subtitle: "From raw signal to metastability"
---

This site covers everything you need to analyse EEG data in Python, using [MNE-Python](https://mne.tools) as the main library. The content follows the structure of the [EEGLAB tutorials](https://eeglab.org/tutorials/), but translated to Python, with examples using simulated data you can run without needing real patient recordings.

## Modules

::: {.module-card}
### [1. Getting started](modules/01-getting-started.qmd)
Installing MNE-Python, understanding the `Raw` and `Epochs` data structures, loading files, and visually inspecting the signal.
:::

::: {.module-card}
### [2. Preprocessing](modules/02-preprocessing.qmd)
Band-pass and notch filtering, re-referencing, resampling, bad channel detection, and interpolation.
:::

::: {.module-card}
### [3. Artifact rejection](modules/03-artifacts.qmd)
Visual inspection, automated epoch rejection, and Independent Component Analysis (ICA) for removing blinks, eye movements, and muscle artifacts.
:::

::: {.module-card}
### [4. Spectral and time-frequency analysis](modules/04-spectral-analysis.qmd)
Power spectral density (PSD), time-frequency decomposition, topographic maps by band, and event-related potentials (ERPs).
:::

::: {.module-card}
### [5. Connectivity and metastability](modules/05-metastability.qmd)
Instantaneous phase via the Hilbert transform, relative phase alignment, dominant eigenvector, and regional metastability computation. The core module for the master's project.
:::

## Libraries used

| Library | Purpose |
|:--------|:--------|
| `mne` | EEG processing: loading, filtering, ICA, spectra, connectivity |
| `numpy` | Numerical operations, linear algebra |
| `scipy` | Hilbert transform, filters, statistics |
| `matplotlib` | Signal visualisation, topographies, spectra |
| `pandas` | Organising demographic and clinical data |
| `pingouin` | ANOVA, post-hoc tests, effect sizes |

## Quick install

```bash
pip install mne numpy scipy matplotlib pandas pingouin
```

Or with conda:

```bash
conda install -c conda-forge mne numpy scipy matplotlib pandas
pip install pingouin
```

## About this site

This site supports the master's project of Natalia Sayuri Melo at the Neuroscience and Cognition programme, UFABC. The project investigates the metastability of resting-state brain dynamics measured by EEG in Parkinson's disease.
